title: P1: goals.py, serve.py and cli polish from approving reviews T-0137 and T-0161
spec:
Low notes left by the approving reviews of the goal runner (T-0137) and serve API (T-0161); none blocking, all small. Fix in place, no behavior change beyond the listed items.
1. goals.py _preview_cfg: catch tomllib.TOMLDecodeError on the target repo's pool.toml and refuse the goal with a clear reason (no traceback).
2. goals.py start(): the Popen of claude must catch FileNotFoundError (claude CLI missing) after the scaffold commit and record a failed goal with reason 'claude CLI not found', leaving the scaffold commit in place.
3. goals.py: the single-goal-per-repo guard runs under the same goals lock as the write (no check-then-act outside the lock).
4. cli.py _format_goal_line prints the goal's note field when present.
5. serve.py: `git clone` argv gets a literal `--` before git_url so a url starting with '-' or an ext:: url cannot be parsed as an option; missing repos.toml returns 503 (service not configured) not 404; get_goal, cancel_goal and the create_goal duplicate check call goals.* inside the same per-slug guard the fan-out uses; _safe_reason redacts bearer tokens and Authorization-style 'key=value' secrets, not only URL credentials; no flock held while awaiting inside the shared threadpool (acquire, read, release).
Tests: extend tests/test_goals.py and tests/test_serve.py with one test per item (names below).
acceptance: tests/test_cli.py or tests/test_goals.py asserts _format_goal_line prints the note

result.summary:
## Summary

Fixed all five low-priority review notes from T-0137/T-0161 in the orchestrator worktree, committed as `6d1be33` on `task/T-0202`.

**Files changed:**
- `orchestrator/goals.py` — `_preview_cfg` now returns `(cfg, reason)` and catches `tomllib.TOMLDecodeError` instead of raising; `start()` catches `FileNotFoundError` from the `claude` launch and records a `status: "failed"` goal (scaffold commit stays); the single-goal-per-repo guard was reworked into `_reserve_running_slot`/`_finalize_running_slot`/`_release_running_slot`, which check-and-write a `"starting"` placeholder inside one `_with_goals_lock` call, closing the prior check-then-act race. Placed right after the scaffold commit so the placeholder file can never leak into that commit.
- `orchestrator/cli.py` — `_format_goal_line` appends `note=...` when the entry has one.
- `orchestrator/serve.py` — `git clone` now gets a literal `--` before the URL; `_load_repos_or_503` returns 503 `"service not configured"` when `repos.toml` is missing (vs. malformed → 503 `"repos.toml unreadable"`); `get_goal`/`cancel_goal` now run under the same per-slug `_with_repo_lock` as `create_goal`; `_safe_reason` gained `BEARER_RE`/`KEYVALUE_SECRET_RE` redaction alongside the existing URL-credential redaction.
- `tests/test_goals.py`, `tests/test_serve.py` — one test per acceptance item, plus a threaded atomicity test for the reservation guard.

**Test output:** all 69 tests in `test_goals.py`/`test_serve.py` pass; `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` exits 0 (full suite, no failures).

Nothing left outstanding for this task.
